channel.title: Garden Rescue
channel.desc: Charlie Dimmock and Amelia Bouquet are in Stockport to transform firefighters Lydia and Katie's weed-ridden patch into a well-being garden with native wildflowers and nature at its heart. The garden would be somewhere to decompress after long shifts at work and a space to practise yoga, enjoy a dunk in their ice bath and share with friends and family. Can the team achieve all of this on a ?4,000 budget?
